latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with enhanced, one-click generation of complete training course packages.

- Instantly generates a full suite of professional training materials, including course outlines, instructor guides, participant handbooks, activity sheets, and evaluation plans.
- Includes marketing and operations documents such as enrollment notices, reminders, and follow-up messages.
- Streamlined workflow collects all key information in one brief for clear, predictable, and ready-to-use outputs.
- Features a reusable framework suitable for skill, knowledge, and behavior-based training programs.
- Provides access to standardized templates for quick customization and high efficiency.
